title: Development and validation of a deep learning model for early detection and screening of diabetic retinopathy.
summary: A zero-shot text-image deep-learning model detects diabetic-retinopathy lesions across five internal and public test sets and an external smartphone set. The paper describes the model operation and predictor inputs as well as the held-out and external evaluation.
ai_technology: The learned model operation and predictor inputs are described in the reviewed Methods.

evidence.tested: Full Methods/Results in NCBI PMC BioC; exact model and held-out/external evaluation reviewed.
evidence.unknown: Generalizability beyond the reported study population, data, and protocol was not established in the reviewed material.
